_comment: Clay — a helpful dragon who answers questions, looks things up, and writes files when asked. No action in this workflow sets a 'root'. That is deliberate: an omitted root is DEFAULT_ROOT ('.'), which clay/run/workspaces.py resolves against the project directory — the one --project-dir names, or the shell's cwd. Naming a root here would either duplicate that or quietly point somewhere else.

boot._comment: Separate from the rest of the context because it is the one file a user is expected to edit before running. Blank values are not papered over — searchWeb's google engine refuses loudly, which is the correct behaviour for a missing credential.
